result:
Changed `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` (bug fixes, now sourcing the new `lib/common.sh`), added the two tests to `tests/run_tests.sh`, and added one README sentence about where the shared helpers live; `backup.sh`, `restore.sh` and `report.sh` are untouched.

Details worth knowing:

- **rotate.sh** — the no-op guard was `-lt` (so exactly N archives fell through to deletion) and `surplus()` used `tail -n +$keep`, which selected the *newest* entries. Now `-le` plus `head -n $((total - keep))`, i.e. delete the oldest `total-keep`.
- **verify.sh** — `awk '{print $2}'` cut the name at the first space (`BAD my (archive missing)`), and the comparison was an unquoted `[ $expected == $actual ]`. The sidecar now splits on the first run of blanks only, so the name keeps its spaces; all four documented output categories (ok / BAD / archive missing / malformed sidecar) still behave the same, checked against fixtures for each.
- `bash tests/run_tests.sh` → all 9 tests pass. I also ran the two new tests against an unfixed copy of HEAD: all three of my new checks fail there, so they do cover the bugs. Flag handling in the refactored scripts is byte-identical to HEAD across 22 invocations (`--help`, `--dest`, `--keep=abc`, `--keep 0`, unknown flags, `--`, positional args, `-n`, `-q`); the only behavioral diff on real fixtures is the intended one — with 4 archives and `--keep 2`, the old code deleted `20260103`/`20260104`, the new code deletes `20260101`/`20260102`.
- Not touched, for your call: `docs/DESIGN.md` §6.1 still describes the parser as copied into all five scripts, and wish-list item 1 (`lib/common.sh`) is now half-done — rotate and verify source it, the other three still carry copies. My scratch repro scripts are in `/tmp/bugrepro` (outside the repo; the sandbox blocked deleting them).
